name: key
doc: Language id, e.g. fi-es. The shipped data/translations/*.xml omit it because the game already knows their id; a translation mod sets it

name: name
doc: Name shown in the language list

name: font_default
doc: Font file (.xml or .bin) for general UI text

name: font_important_message_title
doc: Font file for large on-screen message titles

name: font_world_space_message
doc: Font file for text drawn in the world

name: fonts_utf8
doc: UTF-8 font flag. Every shipped language sets 1

name: fonts_pixel_font
doc: Pixel-font flag. Shipped Latin/Cyrillic languages set 1; CJK languages using the generated Noto fonts omit it

name: fonts_dpi
doc: Font DPI value. No shipped file sets it

name: ui_wand_info_offset1
doc: Per-language UI offset in the wand info box (first value)

name: ui_wand_info_offset2
doc: Per-language UI offset in the wand info box (second value)

name: ui_action_info_offset2
doc: Per-language UI offset in the spell info box

name: ui_configurecontrols_offset2
doc: Per-language UI offset in the Configure Controls screen
